facts.fact: Jupiter Info, relaying Arnaud Nadinga, reports that organic law no. 038-2026/ALP, promulgated on 22 September 2026, creates the Autorite de Regulation de la Communication et du traitement des donnees a caractere personnel (ARCOD), with regulatory and sanction powers, to merge the missions of the CSC and the CIL.

facts.fact: Jupiter Info, relaying Arnaud Nadinga, reports that law no. 037-2026/ALP, adopted on 3 August 2026, repeals the 2021 framework and adds privacy by design, breach notification, impact assessments, a processing register, DPOs and data portability, with six months for controllers to comply.
Jupiter Info reports that organic law no. 038-2026/ALP, promulgated on 22 September 2026, creates ARCOD to supervise personal data protection law alongside media regulation.
